title: Kotlin Foundations
description: Master Kotlin from syntax essentials to idioms and interview problem solving.

chapters.title: Introduction to Kotlin
chapters.summary: Variables, basic types, functions, and string templates.

lessons.title: Kotlin Syntax Essentials
lessons.explanation:
Kotlin is a modern, statically typed language that runs on the JVM, Android, and other platforms.
Variables are declared using `val` (read-only reference) or `var` (mutable variable).
Always prefer `val` for immutability and thread safety.

exercises.prompt: Which keyword declares a read-only local variable in Kotlin?
exercises.explanation: In Kotlin, `val` is used to declare read-only properties and variables.

exercises.prompt: Complete the string template to print the name.
exercises.explanation: Kotlin string templates use the `$` symbol to interpolate variables.

exercises.prompt: What will this program print to stdout?
exercises.explanation: Expressions inside string templates are enclosed with `${}`.

exercises.prompt: Write a function `greet(name: String): String` that returns `"Hello, <name>!"`.
exercises.explanation: Expression body syntax makes one-line functions concise.
